Simulation: Logging into Oracle

This simulation works best on a computer.

Practice logging into Oracle

In this activity, you will practice the steps to log into Oracle, starting from your desktop. Follow the instructions on the right and click on the screen just like you would at work. If you click the wrong spot, you'll get a hint.

This simulation is built for a computer. On a phone, the screens are too small to click accurately.
You will take slightly different steps to log into DEV (training) Oracle.

Step

Thank you for completing this simulation!

Key points to remember:

  • Open Oracle from Trainual, through Software & tools or Quick Links (SD) > Sales.
  • Oracle runs in Internet Explorer mode. Don't click Open in Microsoft Edge.
  • Your username is your first initial plus your last name.
  • Never close the background window while you work. You'll lose unsaved work.
  • Click the compass icon to get back to the Navigator.
